title: Loupe: Reinforcing Knowledge-Intensive Video Generation Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.31895v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Knowledge-intensive video generation remains challenging because prompts often omit the facts, appearances, and temporal relationships required for accurate generation. While search-based workflows can retrieve missing evidence, manually designed strategies limit adaptive planning, and conventional training suffers from costly video-level feedback and coarse trajectory-level credit assignment. In this paper, we present Loupe, a video generation agent that retrieves and verifies textual and visual evidence to construct evidence-grounded temporal video prompts with reference images. We further introduce Rubric-Based Credit (RBC), which leverages prompt-specific factual, visual, and temporal requirements to evaluate intermediate search and planning decisions before video rendering. Building on RBC, RBC-SFT reweights assistant-token learning by step quality, while RBC-GRPO incorporates step-level credits alongside a final planning reward,

translated_title: Loupe：强化知识密集型视频生成智能体
translated_abstract: 知识密集型视频生成仍然具有挑战性，因为提示词往往省略了准确生成所需的事实、外观和时间关系。虽然基于搜索的工作流可以检索缺失的证据，但人工设计的策略限制了自适应规划，而传统训练则面临代价高昂的视频级反馈以及粗粒度的轨迹级信用分配问题。在本文中，我们提出了 Loupe，一个视频生成智能体，它通过检索并验证文本与视觉证据，构建以证据为支撑、带有参考图像的时间化视频提示词。我们进一步引入了基于量规的信用评估机制，利用提示词特定的事实、视觉和时间要求，在视频渲染之前评估中间的搜索与规划决策。在 RBC 的基础上，RBC-SFT 根据步骤质量对助手 token 的学习进行重新加权，而 RBC-GRPO 则将步骤级信用与最终规划奖励相结合……
tldr: 该论文提出 Loupe 视频生成智能体，通过检索并验证文本与视觉证据来构建带参考图像的时间化视频提示词，并创新性地引入基于量规的信用评估机制（RBC），在视频渲染前对中间搜索与规划决策进行评估，从而强化知识密集型视频生成。
en_tdlr: Loupe is a video generation agent that retrieves and verifies textual and visual evidence to construct evidence-grounded temporal video prompts, and introduces Rubric-Based Credit (RBC) to evaluate intermediate search and planning decisions before video rendering, reinforcing knowledge-intensive video generation.
